title: Add raw sensor timestamps and strict LeRobot alignment
goal: Persist complete raw Pico/robot/camera/action timing in PKL and align only during PKL-to-LeRobot conversion on a strict 30 Hz grid for post-training data.
doneWhen: The approved timestamp and conversion rules are documented in Release requirements and operations documentation.
Raw PKL observations retain sensor data and independent timestamps without destructive alignment.
The converter builds a 30 Hz virtual grid and uses nearest samples with per-stream half-period tolerance.
Any missing required stream at any grid point fails conversion with an explicit diagnostic and leaves PKL untouched.
LeRobot output contains only training fields, not Pico controls or diagnostic timestamps.
Focused no-hardware tests cover timestamp capture, strict matching, failure, and training-only output.
decisions: Alignment exists only in PKL-to-LeRobot conversion; collection preserves raw samples and timestamps.
All stream timestamps use a shared host monotonic clock where the source can provide it. Pico retains both vendor timestamp and host receive timestamp.
The converter uses a 30 Hz grid and per-stream half-period tolerance; future or past nearest samples are allowed offline.
Required streams are both cameras, robot state, and actual action. Any unmatched grid point fails the whole conversion; no zero, last-frame, or extrapolated filling.
LeRobot contains training fields only. Pico controls, Pico timestamps, raw events, and diagnostics remain in PKL.

verification.summary: Business implementation updated with frame separation, source periods, bounded asynchronous queue, atomic PKL and transactional sequential export. User requested deferring broad test expansion to operator acceptance. Full real-chain integration and peak RSS remain unverified.
checks: Franka and raw collector focused tests: 34 passed
Alignment and collector focused selection: 5 passed
Real env suite: 243 passed, 1 skipped before latest incremental changes
Actual short PKL to LeRobot write and read: 1 passed
Latest modified Python syntax, collection YAML parse, launcher bash syntax and git diff --check passed
limitations: Raw UVC archival and offline image transformation are implemented; a synthetic transform test passes, but full capture-to-PKL integration remains unverified.
Action post-guard semantics, episode boundaries, actual Gym packaging and stream periods require end-to-end verification. Do not run this partial working tree on hardware.

nextAction: Complete all six acceptance areas: real wrapper/vector/collector integration, raw versus training coordinate semantics, independent periods and failure boundaries, bounded memory/atomic writes, actual LeRobot write/read with transactional output, final regression and operator instructions. User explicitly authorized public-code changes; no hardware control, commit or push authorized.
